cues.en: Instructor: In this video, I'm going to tell you about the Central Limit Theorem, which goes hand in hand with the law of large numbers that you already learned about.
cues.zh: 講師：這部影片介紹中央極限定理，它和你已學過的大數法則密切相連。

cues.en: And there's actually two different implications of the Central Limit Theorem, so I'm gonna talk about two different interpretations of the CLT.
cues.zh: 中央極限定理其實有兩種不同含意，所以會談兩種解讀。

cues.en: And I label the Central Limit Theorem the "all roads lead to Gauss" theorem, and you'll see why.
cues.zh: 我把它稱為「條條大路通高斯」定理，等一下就知道原因。

cues.en: Okay, so here's our first interpretation of the Central Limit Theorem.
cues.zh: 先看第一種解讀。

cues.en: It says, the Central Limit Theorem says, that the distribution of sample means approaches a Gaussian distribution regardless of the shape of the original distribution
cues.zh: 中央極限定理說，樣本平均值的分布會接近高斯分布，不管原本母體

cues.en: of the population, or of the original samples.
cues.zh: 或原始樣本的分布形狀如何。

cues.en: So what does that mean?
cues.zh: 這是什麼意思？

cues.en: That means that if we repeat an experiment multiple times, so we draw fresh samples from a population multiple times, and we get the means of all of those samples,
cues.zh: 如果多次重複實驗，也就是多次從母體抽取新樣本，取得所有樣本的平均值，

cues.en: and we're not averaging them together yet, that's what we do with the law of large numbers, but if we just look at the distribution of those sample means, then that distribution
cues.zh: 先不把它們一起平均，那是大數法則的做法，而是只看樣本平均值的分布，這個分布

cues.en: will approach a Gaussian, that will be normally distributed.
cues.zh: 就會接近高斯，也就是呈常態分布。

cues.en: That's a pretty remarkable statement, because it doesn't actually matter what the shape of the original distribution is.
cues.zh: 這是相當驚人的陳述，因為原始分布的形狀其實不重要。

cues.en: The sample means, or any other sample estimate, it can be the mean, or the variance, or the entropy, or whatever metric it is that you are measuring,
cues.zh: 樣本平均值，或其他任何樣本估計值，可以是平均值、變異數、熵，或正在量測的任何量值，

cues.en: the sample statistics, the sample means, will approach a Gaussian distribution regardless of the shape of the original distribution.
cues.zh: 這些樣本統計量、樣本平均值，都會接近高斯分布，不管原始分布的形狀如何。

cues.en: Okay, so let me show you an example of that.
cues.zh: 舉個例子。

cues.en: Here we have a population distribution, and I know that this is a population because I simulated these numbers in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 這裡是母體分布，我知道是母體，因為數字是我在 MATLAB 中模擬的。

cues.en: So this is a power law distribution, or one over F distribution, so basically that means that larger data values are less and less likely to occur.
cues.zh: 這是冪律分布，或 1/f 分布，基本上表示資料值越大，出現的可能性越低。

cues.en: This is definitely a non-Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 這肯定不是高斯分布。

cues.en: This is pretty much as non-Gaussian as you could possibly get.
cues.zh: 幾乎可以說是極度非高斯的分布。

cues.en: So what do we do?
cues.zh: 那怎麼做？

cues.en: We draw a random sample from this data set and then we compute the mean of that sample.
cues.zh: 從資料集抽一個隨機樣本，計算樣本平均值。

cues.en: Now you could argue that the mean is not really the best measure of central tendency in this data, which is fine, but that's not actually the point for the Central Limit Theorem.
cues.zh: 你可以說，平均值不是這組資料最好的集中趨勢量值，這沒問題，但不是中央極限定理的重點。

cues.en: So we draw a sample of, let's say, I don't know, N equals 50 or 100.
cues.zh: 抽一個樣本，例如 N=50 或 100。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 其實無所謂。

cues.en: And we compute the mean.
cues.zh: 再計算平均值。

cues.en: Then we go back to the population and we draw another sample of the same size, and we compute the mean.
cues.zh: 回到母體，抽另一個大小相同的樣本，再計算平均值。

cues.en: And we go back to this totally non-Gaussian distribution, and draw a sample and compute the mean, and over and over and over again until we get lots of means.
cues.zh: 回到這個完全非高斯分布，抽樣、計算平均，反覆進行，直到取得很多平均值。

cues.en: And then we look at the distribution, the histogram of those means, and amazingly enough, those approach a Gaussian, that looks like a Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 再看這些平均值的分布、直方圖，驚人的是，它們接近高斯，看起來像高斯分布。

cues.en: So the true population mean in this case is one, so it's right around here, is the population mean.
cues.zh: 這個情況下，真正母體平均值為 1，就在這附近。

cues.en: And what you see is that the distribution of sample means is Gaussian distributed even though they are coming from, all of these samples are being drawn
cues.zh: 可以看到，樣本平均值的分布呈高斯，即使它們都來自

cues.en: from the strongly non-Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 嚴重偏離高斯的分布。

cues.en: And these are, again, these are not the distributions of the samples, this is a distribution of the sample means.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這不是樣本資料的分布，而是樣本平均值的分布。

cues.en: Okay, so the Central Limit Theorem tells us that this distribution is a Gaussian, or approaches a Gaussian, as we increase the number
cues.zh: 中央極限定理告訴我們，當抽取的樣本數

cues.en: of samples that we draw.
cues.zh: 增加，這個分布會是高斯，或接近高斯。

cues.en: And the law of large numbers then comes into play, and the law of large numbers tells us that the average of this distribution is getting closer and closer to the true population mean.
cues.zh: 接著大數法則發揮作用，告訴我們這個分布的平均值，會越來越接近真正母體平均值。

cues.en: So you can see that the Central Limit Theorem and the law of large numbers are complementary.
cues.zh: 可以看到，中央極限定理和大數法則互補。

cues.en: They're working with each other here.
cues.zh: 它們在這裡共同作用。

cues.en: The law of large numbers tells us that the average of this distribution is going to be a really great estimate of the population parameter, and the Central Limit Theorem tells us
cues.zh: 大數法則告訴我們，這個分布的平均值會是母體參數很好的估計，而中央極限定理告訴我們，

cues.en: that the distribution of those sample means is a Gaussian, which is also pretty interesting, because that means that the mean of the distribution
cues.zh: 這些樣本平均值呈高斯分布，這也很有趣，因為代表分布的平均值

cues.en: is actually a valid descriptor of the central tendency of the data, of the distribution of sample means.
cues.zh: 確實能有效描述資料，也就是樣本平均值分布的集中趨勢。

cues.en: Okay, so this is kind of the first interpretation of the Central Limit Theorem.
cues.zh: 這就是中央極限定理的第一種解讀。

cues.en: Then we get to what I call part two, which is just a different way of thinking about the Central Limit Theorem.
cues.zh: 接著是我稱為第二部分的內容，只是另一種理解中央極限定理的方式。

cues.en: So the Central Limit Theorem also tells us that random samples from independent variables will tend towards a normal distribution even if the variables themselves
cues.zh: 中央極限定理也告訴我們，來自獨立變數的隨機樣本會趨向常態分布，即使變數本身

cues.en: are not from a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 不是來自常態分布。

cues.en: So essentially what we're doing is we're picking things from the universe at random, and we are putting them together.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是從宇宙中隨機挑東西，再把它們放在一起。

cues.en: We're mixing them together.
cues.zh: 把它們混合。

cues.en: And so it doesn't matter what different things we pick from the universe, or what distributions they come from.
cues.zh: 所以不管從宇宙挑哪些不同東西，或者來自什麼分布，

cues.en: As soon as we put them all together into a pile, that pile is going to start looking like a normal Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 一旦全部放成一堆，這一堆就會開始像常態高斯分布。

cues.en: Now one word of caution or exception here, which is that this statement, so whether the validity of this statement actually depends on some things
cues.zh: 這裡有一個提醒或例外，就是這個陳述是否成立，其實取決於一些因素，

cues.en: like the scaling of the data, possible normalization of the data, usually you need to normalize the data for this to be true.
cues.zh: 例如資料縮放、可能的正規化；通常需要將資料正規化，這才成立。

cues.en: Okay, so let me show you an example of the Central Limit Theorem.
cues.zh: 來看中央極限定理的一個例子。

cues.en: So I'm taking a two data time series.
cues.zh: 取兩條資料時間序列。

cues.en: This one is a sin wave.
cues.zh: 這是正弦波。

cues.en: This is just uniformly distributed noise, so here's what the distributions of these two signals look like.
cues.zh: 這是均勻分布雜訊，它們的分布長這樣。

cues.en: So the sin wave has this distribution that's very much like a sort of U, it's actually almost something called a squircle.
cues.zh: 正弦波的分布很像 U 形，其實有點像所謂 squircle。

cues.en: Have you ever heard of this thing?
cues.zh: 聽過嗎？

cues.en: A squircle?
cues.zh: squircle？

cues.en: A squircle is a square that has rounded corners.
cues.zh: squircle 是有圓角的正方形。

cues.en: Anyway, and pure noise has a flat histogram.
cues.zh: 總之，純雜訊有平坦的直方圖。

cues.en: Well, flat plus pure noise, so.
cues.zh: 好，平坦再加上純雜訊，所以。

cues.en: But the point is neither of these distributions has a Gaussian shape.
cues.zh: 重點是，這兩個分布都不是高斯形狀。

cues.en: Definitely non-Gaussian, definitely non-Gaussian.
cues.zh: 肯定非高斯，這個也肯定非高斯。

cues.en: So then what I do is line up these points, one by one, and sum them together.
cues.zh: 接著把這些點逐一對齊，相加。

cues.en: So that gives us a time series that looks like this.
cues.zh: 得到這樣的時間序列。

cues.en: So I'm just taking this noise and adding it to this sin wave, and what does the distribution, what does the histogram of these data look like?
cues.zh: 只是把雜訊加到正弦波上，而這些資料的分布、直方圖長什麼樣子？

cues.en: Well it's okay, also not exactly like what you'd expect for Gaussian.
cues.zh: 還可以，不完全像預期的高斯。

cues.en: It's a little bit triangular for a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 對高斯而言有點三角形。

cues.en: But you can see that this distribution is approaching a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 但可以看到，這個分布正在接近高斯。

cues.en: It's certainly much more Gaussian than either of these two distributions.
cues.zh: 肯定比前面兩個分布都更像高斯。

cues.en: And that's pretty surprising.
cues.zh: 這相當令人意外。

cues.en: You wouldn't intuitively expect that by mixing together signals that have non-Gaussian distributions, you would get a result that looks more Gaussian
cues.zh: 直覺上，不會預期把非高斯分布的訊號混合，會得到比任一個別分布

cues.en: than either one of these two individually, so pretty surprising.
cues.zh: 都更像高斯的結果，所以很驚人。

cues.en: This is the result of the Central Limit Theorem.
cues.zh: 這是中央極限定理的結果。

cues.en: Now I want to show you a counterexample where the Central Limit Theorem isn't really working.
cues.zh: 現在展示一個反例，中央極限定理似乎沒有發揮作用。

cues.en: And the reason why it doesn't work here is these look basically the same as the previous slide, but that's because I don't have the axes here.
cues.zh: 這裡無效的原因，看起來和前一張投影片基本相同，但那是因為沒有畫座標軸。

cues.en: So you don't actually see what the Y axes are here.
cues.zh: 所以看不到這裡的 Y 軸。

cues.en: So in fact what I did hear was make this noise much, much, much smaller in amplitude compared to this sin wave here, and you can see that here, when we add them together,
cues.zh: 其實我把雜訊振幅設得比正弦波小很多，可以看到，相加後，

cues.en: it just almost looks like, like I just made the line a bit thicker.
cues.zh: 幾乎只是讓線變粗一點。

cues.en: In fact, the line is the same thickness, but it's noisier, but the noise is actually tiny amplitude, because the Y axis scaling here is larger than the Y axis scaling here.
cues.zh: 其實線寬相同，只是比較吵雜，但雜訊振幅非常小，因為這裡的 Y 軸尺度比那裡大。

cues.en: So and then the distribution of this signal is definitely not Gaussian.
cues.zh: 因此，這個訊號的分布顯然不是高斯。

cues.en: It's not even approaching a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 甚至沒有接近高斯。

cues.en: You wouldn't even say that this is more Gaussian than either of these two.
cues.zh: 你甚至不會說，它比原本兩個更像高斯。

cues.en: Okay, so the point here is that this implication of the Central Limit Theorem is true, or is valid, only when the individual signals are appropriately scaled.
cues.zh: 所以重點是，中央極限定理的這個含意，只有個別訊號經過適當縮放時，才成立或有效。

cues.en: Okay, so why is the Central Limit Theorem important?
cues.zh: 那中央極限定理為什麼重要？

cues.en: Well, there's a number of reasons.
cues.zh: 有好幾個原因。

cues.en: Many statistical analyses rely on the assumption of normality, which means a roughly Gaussian distribution, and depending on what you're doing the statistics of,
cues.zh: 很多統計分析依賴常態性假設，也就是大致呈高斯分布；取決於分析對象，

cues.en: you could actually make that assumption without even looking at the data.
cues.zh: 甚至不用看資料，就可以做這個假設。

cues.en: If you were doing analyses on sample estimates, computed over multiple samples, you don't even need to look at the distribution.
cues.zh: 如果分析的是跨多個樣本計算的樣本估計值，甚至不必看分布。

cues.en: You know for sure that they will be normally distributed as long as you have a sufficient number of samples.
cues.zh: 只要有足夠多樣本，就能確定它們會呈常態分布。

cues.en: Okay, so that's one reason why it's important.
cues.zh: 這是重要的原因之一。

cues.en: Another reason why it's important is that Gaussian distributions are really easy to parameterize, and that's because basically everything you need to know about a Gaussian distribution
cues.zh: 另一個原因是，高斯分布很容易參數化，因為要知道高斯分布的一切，基本上

cues.en: comes from just a small number of parameters.
cues.zh: 只需少數幾個參數。

cues.en: So the mean and the variance is usually what we care about for Gaussians, and then there's also skew, which is the third moment, and kurtosis, which is the fourth moment.
cues.zh: 對高斯通常關心平均值和變異數，此外還有第三動差的偏度，以及第四動差的峰度。

cues.en: And it's just really easy to work with Gaussian distributions.
cues.zh: 而且高斯分布非常容易處理。

cues.en: They have a lot of nice statistical properties that make them easy to work with, easy to computer confidence intervals around, and so on.
cues.zh: 有很多良好的統計性質，容易操作，也容易計算信賴區間等等。

cues.en: Furthermore, when you get into advanced signal processing, you might learn about something called the independent components analysis, and is based on the assumption.
cues.zh: 此外，到了進階訊號處理，可能會學到獨立成分分析，它建立在一個假設上。

cues.en: So ICA is a method of taking a multi-variant signal that contains mixed signals, and decomposing it to isolate
cues.zh: ICA 是一種把含有混合訊號的多變量訊號分解，分離出

cues.en: the original independent signals.
cues.zh: 原始獨立訊號的方法。

cues.en: And it's based on the assumption that signals are non-Gaussian distributed, and then when you mix them together randomly, you're going to get a Gaussian distribution,
cues.zh: 其假設是，訊號呈非高斯分布，而隨機混合後，會得到高斯分布，

cues.en: so that's really exactly the second interpretation of the Central Limit Theorem that random mixtures of signals are Gaussian.
cues.zh: 這正是中央極限定理的第二種解讀：訊號的隨機混合呈高斯。

cues.en: Okay, so in this video you learned about the CLT, the all-important Central Limit Theorem.
cues.zh: 這部影片學到了 CLT，也就是非常重要的中央極限定理。

cues.en: And I showed you the two interpretations of the Central Limit Theorem, how the law of large numbers comes into play, and if you only remember one thing
cues.zh: 展示了兩種解讀，以及大數法則如何參與。如果這整章，

cues.en: from this entire section, or this entire course, I would say it's this.
cues.zh: 甚至整門課只記得一件事，我會說就是這個。

cues.en: All road lead to Gauss.
cues.zh: 條條大路通高斯。
